title: Ikkaku Rock's Disappearing Fish
notes: Detective-cast (Conan, Detective Boys, Subaru Okiya) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old lower-fidelity case file's culprit (Aosato Shuuhei) is confirmed correct against the transcript -- no discrepancy there. What the old file missed/flattened: (1) the backstory victim Yoshirou, whose death half a year earlier (drowning after trying to rescue Hikari, who then abandoned him and lied about ever seeing him) is the actual motive, not just an unexplained 'past incident'; (2) the dying message is a double wordplay, not a single decode -- adding kana to the four fish names spells a separate phrase ('I want to meet, come to the desert'), while removing the fish (魚) radical from each fish's kanji spells the culprit's full name 'Aosato Shuuhei'; (3) the regulator mechanism runs in both directions -- the culprit both plants a clean spare regulator on the victim's body (explaining the missing-lipstick clue) and keeps/reuses her damaged, tape-patched original to swim back, which is how her lipstick ended up transferred onto his own mouth (explaining the misplaced bandage clue); (4) Ohto and Kaita are true red herrings with no actual motive against the victim -- the only friction shown between them is Kaita punching Ohto in an unrelated argument about whether to delay the search, tagged red_herring here. case_type: murder.

attrs.decoded_message_kana: adding kana turns the four words into 'aitai kara sabaku no koi, kite' -- 'I want to meet, come to the desert' (saba+ku=sabaku/desert, ai+tai=aitai/want to meet, koi reused as 'come', hirame evokes hirameki/flash of insight)
attrs.decoded_message_kanji: each fish's kanji is [fish radical + phonetic component]; removing the fish radical from all four leaves AO-SATO-SHUU-HEI -- the culprit's full name

attrs.used_to_carve: its roughened edge matches the size of the rock carving

attrs.purpose: signals to searchers that someone had been stranded here

clues.desc: The carved fish names, read as kanji with the shared fish radical removed from all four, spell 'Aosato Shuuhei' -- the culprit's own name, cued by the scratched-off 'FISH' on the victim's watch.
Hikari always dove wearing lipstick, yet the regulator found on her body carries no lipstick trace at all -- proof it was swapped in after her death.

Net-cafe mice are set up for right-handed users (leaning on the left hand), so an acne burst there should be on the left side of the face -- but Aosato's bandage sits away from the left, contradicting his story.
Hikari claimed she never saw Yoshirou during the accident, but her lipstick was found on his own regulator's mouthpiece -- proof she saw him and abandoned him anyway.

edges.method: deliberately stranded without water, died of dehydration

edges.detail: sent a fake 'please handle the rest' email from Hikari's own phone/account to delay the search
Kaita punched Ohto in an argument over whether to delay searching for Hikari
